ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram shows events of a fungal infection in a tree. What stage is shown at F?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a cycle of fungal infection stages in a tree. The label F appears on the right side beside a vertical woody branch or trunk section. That section shows a rough, damaged, swollen or sunken-looking diseased patch on the bark. Reasoning: A localized dead, cracked, or sunken lesion on woody bark is called a canker. Because the image at F is on a substantial woody branch rather than on a leaf or small twig, the stage shown is that cankers form on large branches.
